title: GraphSmith register policy (register — separation-of-duties + activation)
description: Policy that governs approver separation-of-duties and the preconditions under which regulated mode may activate. C2-binding: fail_closed is a const true — the register never relaxes to fail-open; regulated mode activates only when every activation precondition holds against a complete, valid register. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.3.0).

proposer_ne_approver.description: When true, the proposer of a change MUST NOT be its approver (checked fail-closed).

n_of_m.description: Optional threshold: require N distinct valid approvers out of M eligible.

fail_closed.description: Non-negotiable. Any unmet precondition, missing evidence, or ambiguous state resolves to refuse/not-covered, never to pass.

activation_preconditions.description: All must hold for regulated mode to activate. Any false => refuse to activate, loudly.
